answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to lock a meaningful stake that is slashed when duplicate control is proven, so creating fake identities stops being free. Like a lantern left burning on a shared terrace, the stake is visible to all peers and costly to abandon; if two accounts mirror the same keys, behavior, or funding trail, anyone can present that evidence and trigger the slash. Attackers then pay per fake identity, while honest agents lose nothing.
